assertions.observed: Commands: (1) `cd /home/factory-user/repos/menuza/packages/reservations && CI=true npx vitest run src/state-machine.test.ts src/policy.test.ts src/messages.test.ts src/phone.test.ts src/schemas/schemas.test.ts` -> exit 0, 5 files / 16 tests passed (state-machine 5, policy 3, messages 3, schemas 3, phone 2). (2) `cd /home/factory-user/repos/menuza/apps/tenant-api && CI=true npx vitest run src/routes/auth.test.ts` -> exit 0, 1 file / 1 test passed. Source facts: `packages/reservations/src/state-machine.ts:6-20` lists exactly 13 canonical statuses (requested, pending_payment, booked, confirmed, partially_arrived, arrived, partially_seated, seated, finished, cancelled, no_show, declined, expired); `:27-32` actors guest/operator/system/voice (G/O/S/V); per-actor transition tables at `:80-181` (operator `finished: ['seated']` at `:177`); `consumesCapacity` `:39-78`; `quickActionsFor` `:288-350`; `FINISHED_UNDO_WINDOW_MS = 30 * 60_000` at `:37`, enforced for `finished -> seated` at `:219-230` and in quick actions at `:334-344`. `policy.ts` exports all 8 required functions (selectPolicy:59, snapshotPolicy:110, cancellationTerms:148, refundAmount:193, noShowFee:215, platformFeeMinor:241, proportionalFeeRefund:250, currencyMinimum:279). `messages.ts` exports MESSAGE_KINDS (18 kinds, `:8-27`), `scheduleFor` with quiet-hours shifting/skipping (`:89-243`), `dedupeKey` (`:259-274`), `channelsFor` (SMS only when dataRegion==='us' AND smsOptIn truthy, `:288-298`). `phone.ts:7-13` exports `normalizeGuestPhone`; shared with tenant-api via re-export: `apps/tenant-api/src/lib/phone.ts:1` `import { isValidNormalizedPhone, normalizeGuestPhone } from '@repo/reservations'` and `:6` `normalizeGuestPhone as normalizePhone`; `apps/tenant-api/src/routes/auth.ts:22` `import { isValidPhone, normalizePhone } from '../lib/phone.ts'`, called at `:344` and `:448`. Schemas are `z.strictObject` DTOs and every deadline response carries ISO `expiresAt` + server `now` (`schemas/common.ts:15-23`; createHold `schemas/public.ts:114-115`, largePartyRequest `:124-125`, notifyMeOffer `:141-142`, paymentSession `schemas/payments.ts:62-63`, waitlistOffer `schemas/waitlist.ts:57-58`), asserted by `schemas/schemas.test.ts:191` (valid, malformed expiresAt and missing now rejected). `errors.ts:5-30` defines exactly 24 stable error codes (counted: reservations_disabled, online_booking_disabled, location_not_found, service_closed, slot_unavailable, party_size_out_of_bounds, large_party_request_required, large_party_call_only, beyond_booking_horizon, below_min_notice, hold_expired, hold_conflict, idempotency_conflict, invalid_transition, table_conflict, combination_invalid, config_invalid, payment_required, payment_failed, cutoff_passed, rate_limited, turnstile_failed, unauthorized_scope, forbidden_grant) with `ERROR_HTTP_STATUS` mapping all 24 at `:34-61`.
assertions.limitations: The contract's Tool line also names `CI=true npm run test -w @repo/reservations`; per the round's batch plan and concurrency limits I ran the five parent-specified suites instead (engine and property/scale suites belong to other groups). `auth.ts` consumes the shared helper under the alias `normalizePhone` via `src/lib/phone.ts` (same `normalizeGuestPhone` function), not by its original name.

assertions.observed: Command: `cd /home/factory-user/repos/menuza/apps/tenant-api && CI=true npx vitest run src/lib/reservations-routing.test.ts src/lib/reservations-auth.test.ts` -> exit 0, 2 files / 8 tests passed (reservations-auth 5, reservations-routing 3). Rule-by-rule source facts: signature secret `reservations-auth.ts:62` `options?.secret ?? getOperatorToken()` with `secrets.ts:99-102` returning `ENV.TENANT_OPERATOR_TOKEN`; `aud`/`alg` enforced in `jwtVerify` `reservations-auth.ts:80-85` against `RESERVATIONS_TOKEN_AUDIENCE = 'tenant-api-reservations-operator'` (`packages/reservations/src/token.ts:12-13`); `typ` check `:96-102` against `RESERVATIONS_TOKEN_TYP = 'rsv+jwt'` (`token.ts:14`); `exp - iat` cap `:169-177` via `maxTokenTtlSeconds` (`token.ts:56-64`: 300 s when impersonated or sensitive grant, else 900 s); region match `:160-167` (403 region_mismatch); required scope `requireReservationsScope` `:262-278` (403 invalid_scope); grants `requireReservationsGrant` `:211-232` (403 insufficient_permissions; impersonated write/sensitive -> 403 impersonated_read_only); child feature flag `requireReservationsFeatureFlag` `:280-288` (404 when features.enabled or the named child flag is false); `allowsLocation` semantics `token.ts:184-189` (null allows all; otherwise membership; `[]` allows none) with the equivalent enforcement in `requireReservationsLocation` `reservations-auth.ts:295-322`; `rsvGuard` order (feature 404 -> scope 403 -> impersonated write 403 -> grant, plus query/header org mismatch and locationId checks) `reservations-guard.ts:37-101`; active+provisioned org enforced per operator route by `reservations-operator.ts:30-44` (`findActiveOrganizationById` + `hasProvisionedDb` else 404; org/node region mismatch 403), and equivalently for internal `reservations-internal.ts:46-61` and public `reservations-public.ts:44-58` (uniform 404). org-router: `workers/org-router.ts:214-216` `/operator/reservations*` -> `orgIdFromOperatorJwt` (audience list incl. RESERVATIONS_TOKEN_AUDIENCE at `:59-67`); `:220-224` `/reservations` and `/reservations/*` -> customer JWT first, else `orgIdFromOrderIdentity` (Origin + slug/host; the generic `?orgId=` fallback at `:244-247` is unreachable for these paths); `:203-210` `/api/reservations/tick`, `/internal/reservations/*`, `/api/reservations/*`, `/api/voice/actions/*` -> `orgIdFromJsonBody`. Tests covering each rule (all passing): reservations-auth.test.ts:62 (valid token extracts claims), :79 (missing/wrong-secret/expired/staffing aud+typ/wrong typ -> 401), :136 (region mismatch -> 403), :149 (locationIds scoping + null), :185 (rsvGuard: implied grant OK, child flag off -> 404, wrong scope -> 403, impersonated write -> 403, impersonated 900 s TTL -> 401); reservations-routing.test.ts:92 (operator JWT routes, query/body orgId ignored), :113 (/reservations/* Origin-bound, client orgId ignored), :148 (internal/api/voice body-orgId routing, malformed -> null, tick fan-out -> null).
assertions.limitations: `allowsLocation` itself has no direct unit case in these two suites (semantics confirmed by reading `packages/reservations/src/token.ts:184-189`; the enforced path is exercised via `requireReservationsLocation`). The active-but-unprovisioned 404 sweep lives in `reservations-security.test.ts:409`, owned by VAL-FND-020 (another group), and was not run here. The org active/provisioned check is at route level (`reservations-operator.ts:30-44`), not inside `reservations-auth.ts`.

assertions.observed: Command: `cd /home/factory-user/repos/menuza/apps/tenant-api && CI=true npx vitest run src/lib/reservations-write.test.ts` -> exit 0, 1 file / 4 tests passed. Element-by-element: `reservations-write.ts:646` `runExclusive(orgId, async () => {...})`; `:649` `retryOnSqliteBusy(async () => {...})` (helper `sqlite-retry.ts:5-21`); one SQLite transaction `:651` `db.transaction(async (tx) => ...)`; sweep inside it `:652` -> `sweepExpiredInTx` `:157-375` (expired active holds -> expired + occupancies deactivated; pending_payment past paymentExpiresAt -> expired + event; pending_approval past requestDeadlineAt -> expired + event; notified waitlist past responseDeadlineAt -> no_response; also purges expired idempotency keys); idempotency lookup by `(scope, key)` `:664-670`, matching `requestHash` replays stored `responseJson` `:672-682`, mismatched hash throws `conflict('idempotency_conflict')` 409 `:673-677`; fresh day state loaded inside the transaction via `loadDayStateInTx(tx, ...)` `:691` and `:697-703`; caller mutation callback `:754` `const value = await fn(tx, helpers)`; every affected `(locationId, businessDate)` bumped after the callback `:756-766` with `bumpDayVersionsInTx` `:529-569` (insert ... onConflictDoUpdate `version + 1`); idempotency record stored on first execution `:768-791` keyed `(scope, key)` with `requestHash` (48 h TTL, `IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_MS` `:29`); post-commit cache invalidation `:804-808` and outbound hooks `:810-814` run after the transaction resolves and hooks only when `!outcome.replayed`; trigger aborts mapped to 409 `:571-587`. Tests covering each required element (all passing): `reservations-write.test.ts:77` 'executes concurrent writes for the same org sequentially and increments rsv_day_versions atomically' (order `[start:A:v0, end:A, start:B:v1, end:B]`, final day version 2 -> per-org serialization + day-version bump); `:113` 'replays idempotent retries without re-running the callback and rejects conflicting hashes with 409 idempotency_conflict' (replay returns stored value, callback runs once, no extra bump; mismatch -> status 409 / code idempotency_conflict); `:184` 'sweeps expired holds, pending payments, pending requests, and waitlist offers inside the transaction before loading dayState' (swept counts 1/1/1/1, `helpers.dayState` holds/occupancies empty, new occupancy on the exact same slot succeeds proving the sweep precedes constraint checks); `:328` 'maps rsv_table_occupancies overlap trigger aborts to 409 conflict'.
assertions.limitations: `retryOnSqliteBusy` has no dedicated case in this suite (its invocation at `reservations-write.ts:649` and retry loop were verified by source inspection); post-commit ordering (cache invalidation then hooks, skipped on replay) is verified by source (`:804-814`) rather than a dedicated ordering test.
